ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image is a contour topographic map, and the legend on the right shows river lines and contour lines. River section Yi is located in the left-of-center part of the map and is in a river-valley position; near river section Yi, on the south and southeast sides, there are relatively dense contour lines and higher terrain, indicating that slopes or high ground beside the river valley can form shielding. Then reason: In summer from 8:00—10:00 in the morning, the sun is located from the east to the southeast, and river section Yi is easily shielded by the high ground on its southeast or south side, so direct solar radiation is relatively low. Around noon the solar altitude is high and radiation is strong; in the afternoon, although the sun gradually shifts westward, temperature and heat accumulation are relatively large, and shielding conditions are not as good as in the morning. Therefore, to avoid excessive solar radiation, the best recreation time period is 8:00—10:00.
